🚀 Tabularis v0.30.0 is out, and it runs in a browser.

`tabularis web` starts the same app as a server: same React UI, same Rust backend, same connections and settings. Local sessions are authenticated with a one-time token; remote mode refuses to start without a password or an authenticating proxy, an HTTPS URL and an origin allowlist.

Official Docker image for amd64 and arm64, a Compose file and a Helm chart.
